bluf: Converteo is a French data and measurement consultancy, founded 2007, with 450+ consultants and tech experts and the Dékuple group as shareholder since 2014, that now positions itself as an AI and agentic consulting firm. The record shows it moving outward and upward in 2026-06: Toronto and Milan offices, three new partners, and an AI and agentic systems offer for the pharmaceutical industry. A rival should know that its client book on record is empty despite a claim of 200+ clients, that it sells AI visibility while publishing no llms.txt, and that the Horus read marks it Favored with no public pricing model.
doing:
The positioning line, an AI and agentic consulting firm that makes organizations tomorrow ready, transforming operations, business lines and performance with data, AI and agents, from strategy to execution, decodes as a data consultancy that has renamed its front door for the agent era while keeping measurement, CDP and MMM as the substance. The headline claim, quoted as a claim: 450+ consultants and tech experts, 200+ clients and 90 tech partners; the about page also cites first place in the HappyIndex@Work consulting category in 2021 and 2022.

Two lead lines score 3: AI Automation / Agents (the H1 names it an AI consulting firm, with an #Agentic101 series, a Gemini Enterprise offer and the pharma agentic AI launch) and Data & Measurement (the meta bills a 100% data driven consultancy, with MMM, Analytics & CRO, CDP, post cookie and cloud data platform lines). AI Search / GEO scores 2 on a GEO guide, GEO webinars in French and Spanish and a LinkedIn ad on visibility rules changing. Every media line scores 1; B2B, content, creator, retail media and web score 0. The service list runs from Data, AI & Agentic Strategy through Digital Trust & Compliance, Média et acquisition and CDP & Marketing Technologies to Data Foundations, AI & IT; the one proprietary product is the Solution Modélisation Pricing & Promotions; no partners are listed by name.

AI posture: it leads with AI and agentic consulting (roadmaps, governance, agentic operating models, Gemini Enterprise) and publishes GEO guidance on brand visibility in LLMs; the move read marks P1 partial because no audited AI visibility product shows. Pricing signals: none. Moves: 2014, Dékuple group took a stake; 2026-06, an AI and agentic systems offer for the pharmaceutical industry; 2026-06, Toronto and Milan offices opened, three partners named. Conspicuously absent: any named client, case study or job on record, and any feed, schema or entity work beside the GEO guidance.
clients:
The record describes an enterprise client type across retail and ecommerce, CPG and pharmaceuticals, with France as home market and offices listed in France, Spain, Toronto and Milan; the book on record is empty: 0 clients, 0 observed, 0 named only, no mix and no shared clients, against a headline claim of 200+ clients that the record does not itemise. No case study title, URL slug or press line names a client, so no need code is assigned to anyone, and no client on this book can appear on another tracked agency's book.

The only client shaped signal is an ad: one LinkedIn sample asks how Michelin keeps its promotions strategy under control, which reads as a pricing and promotions modelling story, but the needs read does not carry it as a client and this dossier does not either. Inferred from the sold mix, and said as such, a buyer of this firm most plausibly comes for data and measurement (N5) or AI and automation (N9), the two lines scoring 3, with the pharma agentic offer the newest reason to call.

What the base needs next, as a judgment tied to the edition: the Horus read places Converteo best for KJ4 (the platforms are absorbing the execution layer) and KJ9 (measurement gets worse before it gets better), both driven by Data & Measurement, and most exposed to KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out). Enterprise retail, CPG and pharma clients are therefore likely to buy measurement and agentic operating model work from it rather than execution hours, which is what it now sells; moderate confidence, because not one engagement is described in the record.
house: Say and do: 0 of 1 tested lines practised on its own house. AI Search / GEO is contradicted: it sells AI visibility and publishes no llms.txt, with 17 AI topic URLs in its sitemap and no AI crawlers blocked. Paid lines were not tested because none is core. Its own advertising is active on both libraries: the Transparency Center shows 3 text ads, 1 in the last 30 days, under the advertiser Converteo, last shown 2026-09-26; the LinkedIn library shows 9 company page ads, one opening "L’IA Agentique industrialise votre modèle opérationnel" and another "Le plus grand changement dans l’acquisition digitale depuis 20 ans est en marche". Meta and TikTok status is not recorded. Publishing cadence: the sitemap lists 1677 URLs, 47 updated in 90 days and 129 in 365 days. The tag stack is gtm, hubspot and didomi on WordPress, with no social pixels, test tools or ABM stack. Social links: LinkedIn, Instagram, X and Facebook.
market:
The Horus read scores Converteo 17.2 on the tailwind index, 67th percentile, band Favored, sold mix at 15:46 on the Solar Arc, afternoon (Ra to Atum), resilience 36.7. Best placed for KJ4 (the platforms are absorbing the execution layer), carried by Data & Measurement and AI Automation / Agents, and KJ9 (measurement gets worse before it gets better), carried by Data & Measurement. Most exposed to KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out), netting negative even with AI Automation and Data scoring positive, and KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two). Best fit: The Bazaar of Agents, 50/100. Moves: P1, P6, P7 partial; P2, P3, P8 absent; P5 unknown; P4 not applicable.

Monsoon: 51.4, band Breeze, 33rd percentile, migration 58.9 against displacement 43.9. The verdict says 49 of the index is the sold mix, Data & Measurement (9) and AI Automation / Agents (8) carrying the most movable hours; shore 45% Africa and the Maghreb, 30% South and Southeast Asia, 20% Eastern Europe. Footprint inferred, no hub offices or onshore claims.
openings:
The strongest opening is the say and do gap on AI visibility: Converteo publishes GEO guides and webinars and runs a LinkedIn ad about visibility rules changing, yet publishes no llms.txt, and no audited AI visibility product (citation share, scorecard, tracking) shows in its record. A rival leading with an audited citation number and a machine readable house is likely to win the GEO conversation against a firm whose GEO line is guidance rather than product (moderate confidence). Falsifier: an llms.txt on converteo.com or a published AI visibility scorecard at the next compile.

No public pricing model exists, so an outcome priced measurement or agentic offer is a conversation it cannot have in public (likely). The empty client book is the second opening: 200+ clients are claimed and none evidenced, so a rival with described enterprise data or agentic cases has the proof it lacks, and the pharma offer of 2026-06 has no case behind it yet. The contestable lines are media, SEO and CRO, all scoring 1, which a specialist very likely takes without a fight. Monsoon reads Breeze with displacement 43.9, so a price only pitch is unlikely to work against an enterprise consultancy.

Indicator I7, holiday 2026 agentic checkout volume and merchant opt out rates, next reading December 2026 to January 2027: disclosed AI checkout GMV would strengthen KJ4, the judgment Converteo is best placed for.
The dated moves to follow up are the 2026-06 Toronto and Milan openings and the pharma agentic offer: a first named pharma case or a case index would fill the empty client book.
The next Radar compile after 2026-09-28 refreshes offices, ads, sitemap cadence and clients; an llms.txt appearing would close the one contradiction on record.
